gloss: calligraphy and painting; written and visual art

definitions.gloss: calligraphy and painting; works of brush art
definitions.explanation: The combined art of calligraphy (brush writing) and painting, traditionally viewed as closely related disciplines in East Asian culture. Also refers to individual works or collections that include both calligraphic and pictorial pieces.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{書|しょ}→〜書：28467_sho⟧ (writing, calligraphy) and {画|が} (picture, painting). In East Asian tradition, calligraphy and painting share the same fundamental tool — the brush — and are considered sister arts. The two are often practiced, displayed, and collected together.

{書画|しょが} appears frequently in art criticism, museum exhibitions, and discussions of traditional Japanese and Chinese culture. Works of {書画|しょが} are commonly displayed in the ⟦{床|とこ}の{間|ま}→床の間：05797_tokonoma⟧ (alcove) of a traditional Japanese room.
